policy: Time-limited, separately predeclared noisy CIFAR interpolation bracket. Train widths 128 then 64 at seed 409 with the same frozen CNN80 features, training-label noise map, splits, depth-one allocated topology, Adam settings and 1200-epoch node budget as the completed wide follow-up. Resume exact root/child tasks from original 400-epoch checkpoints; changed child tasks restart. Do not choose widths or stop based on held-out scores. Withhold test until both declared models finish. Stop at the next saved epoch after 48 wall-clock minutes; incomplete nodes are not 1200-epoch results and never enter the final capacity curve. Keep completed older results untouched. This adds one optimizer seed below the previously evaluated 256/512/1024 widths, not a three-seed repetition or a guaranteed full double-descent result.
